original_goal:
[Module: Logout | TC-002 | Type: Positive | Priority: High]
Title: After logout, accessing a protected page redirects to Login page

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html
▶ Requires Auth: No
▶ Test Data:
{
  "username": "standard_user",
  "password": "secret_sauce",
  "protected_url": "https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html"
}

Preconditions:
  Test will authenticate using standard_user to reach a page with a visible Logout option, then perform logout.

Steps to Execute:
  1. Open https://www.saucedemo.com/ (Login page).
  2. Enter 'standard_user' in Username field
  3. Enter 'secret_sauce' in Password field
  4. Click the Login button
  5. On the Inventory page, click the Menu (burger) button
  6. Click the 'Logout' link in the side menu
  7. Attempt to open a protected page by navigating to https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html

Expected Result:
  Attempting to access the protected page redirects to the Login page; the Login page is displayed

Notes from prior verification:
  Original step to click Logout was not executable against the captured DOM (Login page). Added explicit login steps to reach Inventory where the Logout control exists, then perform logout. Kept the protected-URL navigation step unchanged.
